conditions: commodity_category in ['cement', 'fertilizer', 'agricultural_farm_produce'] and net_quantity_metric_weight > 50.0 and unit == 'kg'
exclusions: retail_packages <= 25.0 kg or <= 25.0 L
cement, fertilizer, and agricultural farm produce bags <= 50.0 kg
exemptions: Exempt from all Chapter II Retail Package Declarations (MRP, USP, Consumer Care, Month/Year of Mfg, Front PDP Font sizing Table-I).
decision_logic: if (commodity_category in ['cement', 'fertilizer', 'agricultural_farm_produce']): if (net_quantity_value > 50.0 and unit_symbol in ['kg', 'kilogram']): is_retail_rule_applicable = False; else: if (net_quantity_value > 25.0 and unit_symbol in ['kg', 'kilogram', 'L', 'litre']): is_retail_rule_applicable = False;

conditions: bought_directly_from_manufacturer == true || bought_directly_from_importer == true || bought_directly_from_wholesale_dealer == true
exclusions: packaged commodities sold through retail shops or retail dealers to individuals
institutional packages bought for commercial or trade purposes (redefined in G.S.R. 385(E))
exemptions: Complete exemption from LMPC Chapter II Retail Declarations (MRP, USP, Consumer Care, Standard sizing, Table-I PDP font metrics).
decision_logic: if (distribution_channel in ['industrial_direct', 'institutional_direct'] and 'not for retail sale' in declarations_on_package): is_retail_rule_applicable = False;

exclusions: packages of net quantity > 10.0 g or > 10.0 ml
tobacco and tobacco products (explicitly excluded w.e.f. 1-7-2016 by G.S.R. 385(E))
pan masala products (explicitly excluded w.e.f. 1-2-2026 by G.S.R. 881(E))
exemptions: Complete exemption from LMPC Chapter II retail package declarations.
decision_logic: if (commodity_category not in ['tobacco', 'tobacco_products', 'pan_masala']): if (net_quantity_value <= 10.0 and unit_symbol in ['g', 'gram', 'ml', 'millilitre']): is_retail_rule_applicable = False;

package_category: Restaurant and Hotel Packed Fast Food
exclusions: pre-packaged processed food manufactured/packed in standard food processing factories
exemptions: Complete exemption from LMPC Chapter II retail package declarations.
decision_logic: if (packer_type in ['restaurant', 'hotel', 'fast_food_outlet'] and commodity_category == 'fast_food'): is_retail_rule_applicable = False;

exclusions: medical devices declared as drugs (explicitly excluded from DPCO exemption w.e.f. 1-1-2018 by G.S.R. 629(E))
general wellness cosmetics or dietary supplements
exemptions: Exemption from Chapter II retail rules for scheduled/non-scheduled formulations covered under DPCO 2013.
decision_logic: if (commodity_category == 'drug_formulation' and is_covered_under_dpco == True and is_medical_device == False): is_retail_rule_applicable = False;

package_category: Readymade Loose Garments or Hosiery sold open
exclusions: packaged readymade garments sold sealed in boxed packets or plastic wraps without direct inspection option
semi-finished raw textiles or industrial rolls
exemptions: Exempted from Month and Year of Manufacture (Rule 6(1)(d)), Net Quantity (Rule 6(1)(c)), and standard PDP font millimeter scales (Rule 7 Table-I). Required to display strictly 5 core declarations: (1) Name & complete address of manufacturer/marketer/brand owner/importer with Country of Origin, (2) Consumer care email & phone, (3) International sizes (S/M/L) with cm/m metric details, and (4) MRP.
decision_logic: if (commodity_category in ['garment', 'hosiery'] and packaging_state == 'loose' and product_stage == 'finished'): apply_rules_list = ['MFR_NAME_ADDR_DECLARATION', 'COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN_DECLARATION', 'CONSUMER_CARE_EMAIL_PHONE_DECLARATION', 'SIZE_METRIC_INDICATORS', 'MRP_DECLARATION']; is_mfg_date_required = False; is_net_quantity_required = False; is_table_1_font_height_required = False;

exclusions: standard pre-packaged commodities sold online in factory-sealed containers
exemptions: Exempted from packing/manufacture dates. The delivery box and digital page must display strictly: (1) Name/address/Country of Origin of manufacturer/marketer/brand owner/importer/seller, (2) Consumer Care details, (3) MRP, and (4) Net Quantity in metric units or numbers.
decision_logic: if (distribution_channel == 'ecommerce' and packaging_state == 'loose' and consumer_awareness == True): apply_rules_list = ['NAME_ADDRESS_ORIGIN_SELLER_DECLARATION', 'CONSUMER_CARE_EMAIL_PHONE_DECLARATION', 'MRP_DECLARATION', 'NET_QUANTITY_DECLARATION']; is_mfg_date_required = False;

exclusions: non-electronic general packages (food, toys, household chemicals)
electronic products not declaring details via QR code
exemptions: Permitted to declare manufacturer/packer/importer registered postal address, generic name of commodity, and product dimensions/size via scannable QR code instead of physical package surface text. Mandatory to print manufacturer/packer/importer name, consumer care telephone and email, and QR scan instruction physically on the package label.
decision_logic: if (commodity_category == 'electronic_product' and qr_code_declared == True): allow_qr_relocation = ['manufacturer_address', 'common_generic_name', 'dimensions_size', 'consumer_care_other_info']; require_physically_printed_on_package = ['manufacturer_name', 'consumer_care_telephone', 'consumer_care_email', 'qr_scan_instruction_text'];

exclusions: non-medical consumer health goods
cosmetics and general toiletries
exemptions: Bypasses standard LMPC Principal Display Panel Table-I numeral/letter heights and width metrics. Mandates that the declarations, character height, and character width specifications of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 shall apply. Standard LMPC Rule 33 package relaxations shall not apply.
decision_logic: if (is_medical_device == True): bypass_rules_list = ['LMPC_Table_I_font_heights', 'LMPC_letter_numeral_width_ratio', 'LMPC_Rule_33_relaxation']; apply_regulatory_code = 'Medical Devices Rules, 2017';

package_category: Standard Packages of Unit Metric Sizing
exclusions: packages of fractional net quantities (e.g. 450 g, 750 ml, 2.5 m)
exemptions: Declaration of Unit Sale Price (USP) is not required on the package or label because the Retail Sale Price (MRP) is mathematically equal to the Unit Sale Price.
decision_logic: if (net_quantity_value == 1.0 and unit_symbol in ['kg', 'kilogram', 'L', 'litre', 'm', 'metre', 'N', 'number', 'unit', 'piece', 'U']): is_unit_sale_price_required = False;

exclusions: single standard pre-packaged retail commodities
exemptions: Declaration of Unit Sale Price (USP) is not required on combination, group, or multi-piece promotional packages.

exclusions: spare parts and accessories sold directly to retail consumers in open markets
exemptions: Completely exempted from the mandatory declaration of Month and Year of Manufacture.
decision_logic: if (is_warranty_spare == True and is_sold_to_end_customer == False): is_manufacturing_date_required = False;
